I'm honored to be a member of the **BosphorusBytes** project team.

Below, you'll find a brief summary of our project. To access a detailed project description, please go to [BosphorusBytes Project Page](https://emu-hacettepe-analytics.github.io/emu430-fall2024-team-bosphorusbytes-3).

**Summary**

Our project analyses the Istanbul Airbnb dataset from Inside Airbnb, which covers approximately 20,000 listings across the city. We investigate how short-term rentals are distributed across Istanbul's districts, what factors drive listing prices, how the market evolved over time including the impact of COVID-19, and whether the platform is increasingly dominated by professional multi-listing hosts. Using exploratory data analysis, spatial mapping, time-series analysis, and a custom Tourism Pressure Index, we find that listings are heavily concentrated in central tourist districts such as Beyoglu and Sisli, entire-home listings command a significant price premium, and a small group of professional hosts controls a disproportionate share of supply.
